model.name: student
model.architecture: StudentModel (CSPDarknetNano + PANet + decoupled anchor-free head, no DFL)

steps: Decode the image to 8-bit RGB (the training loader reads BGR with cv2.imread and converts BGR->RGB).
Letterbox: scale = image_size / max(w, h); new_w = floor(w * scale), new_h = floor(h * scale).
Resize to (new_w, new_h) with bilinear interpolation (cv2.INTER_LINEAR).
Paste centered on an image_size x image_size canvas filled with pad_value on every channel: pad_x = (image_size - new_w) // 2, pad_y = (image_size - new_h) // 2.
Per channel: value = (pixel / 255 - mean[c]) / std[c], float32.

outputs.channels: mask coefficients of each anchor, same anchor order as boxes_raw
prototype masks, NCHW, at 1/4 of the input resolution

anchors.order: level-major (finest stride first), then row-major within a level (y outer, x inner)

decode.box_units: pixels of the letterboxed image_size x image_size input (dx/dy are NOT scaled by stride)
decode.candidates: one candidate per (anchor, class) with score > conf_threshold

nms.type: greedy, per class (class-aware / batched), on xyxy boxes, highest score first

decode.to_original_image: x = (x_letterboxed - pad_x) / scale, y = (y_letterboxed - pad_y) / scale, clip to image

segmentation.assembly: For each detection kept by the box decode, take the coefficient vector of the anchor it came from (row i of mask_coefs, the same i as in boxes_raw). mask = sigmoid(coefs . protos), with protos flattened to (nm, h*w) and the result reshaped to (h, w). Crop it to the detection box in prototype coordinates (box in letterboxed pixels / mask_ratio): pixels outside the box are zeroed. Optionally upsample bilinearly to the input size. Threshold at `threshold`. Letterbox padding and the ROI crop are undone on the mask exactly as on the box.
